description: This file defines a custom runtime exception class named GLClosureDuplicateException, which extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException. It is used to indicate that a GL (General Ledger) closure for a specific date and office already exists, preventing duplicate closures.

classes.name: GLClosureDuplicateException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a duplicate GL closure exists for a given office and date.

methods.name: GLClosureDuplicateException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new instance of GLClosureDuplicateException with office ID and closure date, passing a formatted error message to the superclass.
